newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed fund declines Marietta tender.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed fund declines Marietta tender.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Inc said on Thursday U.S. Trust Co of California, which serves a trustee for various company employee benefits plans, said it did not intend to exchange Lockheed shares for Martin Marietta Materials Inc shares.
U.S. Trust also did not intent to direct the exchange of Lockheed shares for which it had fiduciary responsibility, into Marietta shares, Lockheed said.
Lockheed said U.S. Trust evaluated the exchange offer in the context of employee plans and that it did not evaluate the exchange offer from the viewpoint of any other shareholder.

Lockheed began a tender offer on September 16 to exchange 4.72 shares of Martin Marietta Materials shares it owned for each share of Lockheed validly tendered, up to a maximimum 7.9 million Lockheed shares.

The company said U.S. Trust's decision did not affect any shares validly tendered by participants in Lockheed Martin employee plans by October 11. If instructions were not received by then, U.S. Trust had fiduciary responsibility for the shares in employee accounts, it said.
It also had fiduciary responsibility for unallocated Lockheed Martin shares in the Lockheed Martin Salaried Employee Savings Plan Plus, Lockheed said.
The offer expired on October 18, it said.
